name: Inshin Miko
source:
During a date in an amusement park hero gets "demon soul" attached to his chest. The girl who did it is a foreign priestess and queen candidate. She asks hero to eliminate other candidates by depriving them from virginity. "Demon soul" attached to the chest slowly eats the soul and there's no other choice but cooperate.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在游乐园约会期间，男主角的胸口莫名被种下了一枚“魔魂”。设下这一禁制的少女是来自异国的巫女，同时也是女王候选人之一。她要求男主角夺走其他女王候选人的处女之身，借此将竞争对手逐一淘汰。由于附在胸口的“魔魂”正一点点蚕食着他的灵魂，男主角别无选择，只能乖乖就范与她合作。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-may-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
